stage_iii.quote: Lugano 2014 stage IIIB with bulky disease (X) and no E lesion

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: I score this as splenic (nodal, S) involvement rather than extranodal disease, so he is not stage IV

mol_de_not_dh.quote: so he is not double-hit or triple-hit and DA-EPOCH-R is not indicated on present data

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: That is the intermediate band (2-3), not high (4-6).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP every 21 days for 6 cycles, with primary G-CSF prophylaxis from cycle 1.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: If polatuzumab cannot be obtained or covered, I would give R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles without delay

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4-5 at the retroperitoneal bulk would prompt consolidation involved-site radiation to the bulky site

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I do not plan a dose reduction at the start

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily now (no renal adjustment at eGFR 96) and continue at least 12 months after the last rituximab dose.

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: Send quantitative HBV DNA and ALT now and monitor every 1 to 3 months on therapy.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no CNS prophylaxis and no routine baseline brain MRI or lumbar puncture.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT 3 to 6 weeks after cycle 6 is the decision point. Deauville 1-3 is complete metabolic response

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: or biopsy if the residual is small and the result would change management
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy offered as alternative to ISRT rather than as the default before changing therapy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis: allopurinol 300 mg daily starting 2 days before cycle 1, with oral hydration.

sup_gcsf.quote: Pegfilgrastim (or biosimilar) on day 4 of each cycle

work_echo_reviewed.quote: He is fit for full-intensity pola-R-CHP: age 62, ECOG 1
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 58% is listed among fitness factors rather than explicitly as permitting anthracycline.
